# Brand Standards

> Generated by Tastefield from this repository's design system. These standards are served to AI coding agents over MCP and enforced by `tastefield check`.

## Component Contracts (Structural Standards)

### `prefer-design-system-components` — error · advisory

Use the project's existing components instead of writing raw HTML elements for anything the system already covers. Call get_component_contract before rendering a component to confirm its valid props.

**Instead:** Available components include: Button, Card, CardHeader, CardFooter.

### `no-invented-variants` — error · advisory

Never pass a variant or size value that isn't declared in the component's contract. If the value you want doesn't exist, stop and ask rather than inventing one.

**Instead:** Button: variant=default|secondary|ghost|destructive, size=sm|md|lg · Card: elevation=flat|raised

### `no-restyling-primitives` — warn · advisory

Never apply layout or color utility classes directly to a UI primitive to change its appearance. Extend the component's variants instead.

**Instead:** If a new visual treatment is genuinely needed, add a variant to the component rather than overriding at the call site.

## Brand Boundaries (Guardrails)

### `no-raw-hex` — error · enforced

Never write raw hex colors in markup or styles. Use the design system's color tokens.

**Instead:** Use a defined color token instead, e.g. var(--color-background), var(--color-foreground), var(--color-primary).

### `no-arbitrary-color-utility` — error · enforced

Never use Tailwind's built-in color palette utilities (bg-blue-500, text-red-600). Those colors are not part of this brand.

**Instead:** Use a semantic token utility bound to the design system (e.g. bg-primary, text-muted-foreground).

### `no-arbitrary-values` — error · enforced

Never use Tailwind arbitrary-value brackets for spacing, sizing or color (p-[17px], w-[342px], bg-[#fff]). Every value must come from the scale.

**Instead:** Pick the nearest step on the defined spacing/sizing scale instead.

### `no-inline-border-radius` — warn · enforced

Never override border-radius inline. Radius is a system-level decision.

**Instead:** Use the radius tokens: var(--radius-sm), var(--radius-md), var(--radius-lg).

## Voice & Copy Standards

### `no-marketing-filler` — warn · enforced

Never use hype words in UI copy: seamless, effortless, unlock, revolutionize, supercharge, delight, magic, game-changing.

**Instead:** State plainly what the thing does.

### `empty-states-need-action` — warn · advisory

Every empty state must end with a primary action the user can take. Never ship an empty state that only describes the absence of content.
